description: Close one relay session. Connected players lose their relay connection. Delete every session you created for testing before ending your task. Takes exactly one session_id; empty IDs, wildcards and lists are refused.

dry_run.description: Show the exact request (method, host, path, body) with secrets masked, and send nothing. Local checks still run. Use it to confirm a billable or destructive call before making it.

session_id.description: The exact session_id of the one session to delete, e.g. "0724828881e2-S".

name: edgegap_delete_relay_session
title: Delete a relay session
